plan.workflow: Import reviewed source-bound seed draft, review neighboring suggestions without autoacceptance, undo an explicit mask brush, save/reopen draft, review six manual refinements, preview and apply a new garment, save/reopen exact wardrobe, export and close editor before independent playback.
plan.limits: Anchor-based suggestions are proposals, not optical-flow correspondence or automatic anatomical segmentation. Manual six-pose artwork is labeled separately.

scope: Production UI mask editing, explicit per-pose review, real downloads and independent player. No mocks or substituted runtime assets.
